summary: Patch the independently audited v0.8.0 correctness, confinement, idempotency, integrity, validation, context-metric, and measured performance findings as bounded v0.8.1-dev hardening.

candidates.rationale: Require explicit recovery for stale locks so normal acquisition cannot delete a replacement owner lock.
Confine generated projection destinations and cover Windows junction/symlink escape attempts.
Resolve lifecycle idempotency under the run lock before deriving mutable-state payloads or timestamps.
Revalidate registered final-artifact integrity before committing RUN_COMPLETED.
Package the exact planned bytes, reserve generated member names, reject source/output collisions, and atomically replace completed archives.
Apply one effective cache-enabled gate to both cache loading and inline cache consumption.
Validate mandatory authority inheritance and file/directory policy structure before context planning.
Bind typography entries to the renderer-consumed textStyle schema and validate consumed page/palette/spacing fields.
Stop overclaiming PDF fidelity by reporting unsupported renderer controls separately from dependency availability.
Normalize text newlines, distinguish worktree scope, and align orientation metrics with configured startup context.
Batch Git-ref blob reads instead of launching one git show process per file.
Use full replay by default while retaining checkpoints as explicit compatibility/verification snapshots.
Reject nonfinite growth thresholds, invalid previous versions, and empty release-note sections.
Open the verified v0.8.1-dev correctness hardening patch line without changing the published v0.8.0 tag.
